rows.notes: Candidate S5 corporate-exit case. Promotion needs user migration/shutdown evidence and clear separation from EU Russia sanctions package events.

Candidate S5 asset-listing case. Promotion needs exact pair-removal state, withdrawal/deposit suspension evidence, and attribution wording that does not overclaim a public legal trigger unless a policy rationale is archived.

Promoted 2026-05-16 (Phase 4 of 2026-05-16 staged-release plan, Agent C #3 promotion candidate). DRYRUN: evidence captured as replayable Wayback URLs with evidence_use=contextual_unarchived; body-hash captures deferred to a follow-on pass before non-DRYRUN release. See events/uk-fca-binance-markets-2021.yaml.
Candidate S4 direct-disable order. Promotion needs Binance implementation notice, Malaysian app/web access evidence, or anchored no-change coverage.
Candidate S4 Dutch registration/access case. Promotion needs a decision on whether the 2021 warning, 2022 fine, and 2023 exit are one longitudinal event or separate target-level trigger units.

Candidate S4 Singapore access-restriction case. Promotion is blocked until the MAS investor-alert / directive source and Binance Singapore restriction notice are captured as replayable primary or semi-primary evidence.
Candidate S4 Canada exit case. Promotion needs the Binance Canada withdrawal notice and user off-boarding/access-restriction evidence linked to CSA 21-332.

Candidate S4 platform-access case. Promotion needs archived FSMA source, Binance Belgium user migration / withdrawal notice, and at least one replayable frontend or account-access observation for Belgian users.

Candidate S4 multi-platform block case. Promotion should split or explicitly model target-level units if Binance, KuCoin, OKX, Kraken, and others show distinct app-store, web, or registration outcomes.
Candidate S4 website/app blocking case. Promotion needs the NTC order or SEC block-request source captured locally plus web/app accessibility evidence.

Candidate S6 full-ban case. Promotion needs platform notices or archived account-service restrictions showing crypto wallet/account/custody services blocked for Russian persons or residents.

Historical-baseline SEC Bitcoin enforcement candidate. Promotion needs replayable case filings and a scoped platform/asset/rail observation rather than relying on the SEC press release alone.

Historical-baseline marketplace seizure candidate. Promotion needs website seizure evidence, forfeiture/order anchors, and wallet-level asset evidence that can be represented without contaminating 2017+ comparable denominators.
class-level administrative rulings with no named enforcement target
Historical-baseline SEC unregistered-offering candidate. Promotion needs archived SatoshiDICE / FeedZeBirds surface evidence or a defensible no-change coverage row.
Historical-baseline DOJ exchange/MSB candidate. Promotion needs a clean target split between BitInstant and BTCKing plus evidence of platform or rail-state change.

Historical-baseline DOJ unlicensed Bitcoin exchange candidate. Likely baseline-only unless a replayable exchange surface or custody/rail reaction can be recovered. | Historical-baseline SEC virtual stock-exchange candidate. Promotion requires archived exchange-domain state and a target-level decision on BTC Trading versus LTC-Global.

Historical-baseline FinCEN/XRP candidate. Promotion needs settlement/order anchors and a conservative observation surface; do not treat general AML undertakings as a layer change without replayable evidence.

Historical-baseline CFTC Bitcoin options candidate. Promotion needs archived Derivabit platform evidence and whether the cease-and-desist produced a measurable service-state change. | Historical-baseline CFTC Bitcoin swap candidate. Promotion likely needs a narrow market-venue observation or should remain baseline-only.
Historical-baseline Bitfinex/CFTC candidate. Promotion needs evidence of custody, margin, or U.S.-user service changes tied to the order.
Historical-baseline court/IRS summons candidate. Promotion needs Coinbase response or narrowed production-order evidence; the legal order alone is not a service-layer change.
Candidate S3 takedown case. Promotion needs domain seizure / marketplace frontend evidence and a decision on whether AlphaBay and Hansa are one joint operation event or separate frame units.
Candidate S3 mixer case. Promotion needs Wayback/domain-state evidence for Helix or Grams surfaces and any custody/offramp response evidence.
Candidate S3 exchange-enforcement case. Promotion needs BitMEX user-region restrictions, KYC / access-change evidence, or anchored no-change coverage after the CFTC/DOJ action.
Candidate S3 product-removal case. Promotion needs replayable BlockFi product pages or customer notices showing halt to new US interest-account offerings.
Candidate S3 service-removal case. Promotion needs archived Kraken terms, help-center, or customer-facing notice showing US staking shutdown.
Candidate S3 direct platform-shutdown case. Promotion needs archived Beaxy shutdown/customer-return pages and a replayable frontend observation.
Candidate S3 exchange-enforcement case. Promotion needs evidence of US off-boarding, access restrictions, plea-related market exit, or anchored no-change coverage.
